title: PolicyObject
description: One atomic, source-resolvable object extracted from a labelled Segment. Used identically for benchmark-side objects and customer-pack-side objects -- the recommender compares two lists of these.

source_ref.description: Human-resolvable pointer back to the exact source location, e.g. 'page 4, clause 3.2'. Never null -- this is the field the whole traceability guarantee rests on.

concept_id.description: RRL-<TOPIC>-xxxx or DRL-<TOPIC>-xxxx if mapped to a reference concept.

parameters.description: Organisation/source-specific values: threshold_value, currency, approver, timing_days, etc. Never baked into the concept itself.

pack_origin.description: Which side of the comparison this object belongs to. Not part of core Policron schema, added here so one table can serve the comparator.
